title: Ordered finite Tate pullback around a commutative square
statement: Let A be a commutative ring killed by N and t an OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport, normalized on roots and pure coefficient/root tensors [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Put T_X=A_X(d)[2d] in the ordered tensor presentation of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], for d≥0. For maps s:Y→X, s′:Y′→X′, b:Y′→Y and v:X′→X satisfying s′v=bs, assume N is invertible on X,Y,X′. Write c_f:f* T_target ≅ T_source for vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback and e for the inverse-image compositor from b*(s*(-)) to s′*(v*(-)), constructed around this square. Then b*(c_s^{-1}) followed by e on T_X followed by s′*(c_v) equals c_b followed by c_s′^{-1}. This is only an equality of coefficient maps; no compact support, dualizing object or integration occurs.

proof.text: Apply the ordered coefficient composition law to b followed by s and to s′ followed by v, using hs.symm for the second composite. Cancel the inverse and forward coefficient comparisons and use functoriality of ordinary pullback to obtain the displayed square.

lean.statement:
theorem orderedTatePullbackSquare (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ X) (s' : Y' ⟶ X')
    (b : Y' ⟶ Y) (v : X' ⟶ X) (hs : s' ≫ v = b ≫ s)
    (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hX' : IsUnit (N : Γ(X', ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A b).map
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t s hX d).inv ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b s).inv.app
        (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA X d) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) s' v (b ≫ s) hs.symm).hom.app
        (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA X d) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A s').map
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t v hX d).hom =
    (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t b hY d).hom ≫
      (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t s' hX' d).inv
